facts.text: The default scope driver speaks the InfiniiVision-compatible SCPI set (:CHANx:SCAL, :TIM:SCAL, :TRIG:EDGE, :MEAS:*, :WAV:PRE? plus an IEEE-488.2 definite-length block) and covers Keysight, Rigol, Siglent, Rohde & Schwarz and GW Instek scopes
identify queries *IDN? and passes the reply to parse_idn
parse_idn splits the *IDN? reply into vendor, model, serial and firmware
run, stop and single write :RUN, :STOP and :SINGle
capture selects :WAV:SOUR, sets :WAV:FORM WORD and :WAV:BYT LSBF, reads :WAV:PRE? and :WAV:DATA?, and returns a Waveform with points and vpp metadata
measure queries :MEAS:VPP?, :MEAS:VRMS?, :MEAS:VMAX?, :MEAS:VMIN?, :MEAS:FREQ? and :MEAS:PER? on the requested channel
safe_float returns None instead of a value whose magnitude is above 1e30
measure_all queries the 16-item InfiniiVision measurement set and tags each value with the unit V, Hz, s or %
The VISA transport opens a pyvisa resource with a default timeout of 5000 ms and newline read and write terminators
VisaTransport serializes write, query and query_raw on a lock and closes both the instrument handle and the resource manager
The oscilloscope tab has four channels with V/div, offset, coupling and probe attenuation, timebase and trigger controls, Run/Stop/Single, and a measurement strip read back from the instrument
The control-to-SCPI table maps set_channel, set_timebase, set_trigger, set_acquisition and run/stop/single to the Keysight dialect
The measurement strip polls the full 16-item InfiniiVision set on demand, Keysight's ~9.9E37 invalid sentinel is filtered to null, and the 5 Hz stream carries only the light six-measurement set
The scope front-end absolute maximum is 5 V at 50 ohm and 300 V at 1 Mohm, scaled by probe attenuation
The runtime has scope_capture and scope_measure_vpp functions that call capture(1) and measure_vpp(1)
